<!-- def-equiv-ok: the chain spells out the map that defines it -->
#### Affine map, affine transformation, affine function

A [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) $f: \reals^p \to \reals^m$ is an **affine map**
(also called an **affine transformation** or **affine function**)
if it is a matrix product followed by a translation (@def-translation)
(a [composition](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-composition), with the matrix product as the [inner function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-inner-function)):
there are an $m \times p$ matrix $\matr{A}$ and a vector $\vec{b} \in \reals^m$ such that

$$
\begin{aligned}
f(\vx)
&= t_{\vec{b}}(\matr{A} \vx) \\
&= \matr{A} \vx + \vec{b} \quad \text{for all } \vx \in \reals^p
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
